column1: # WARN COHORT TRACKER — LIVE (created 2026-07-10). Rolling filing-level ledger for the WARN->claims framework (LABOR's #1 tool, r=0.78 at ~6wk lag).

# PURPOSE: map each MATERIAL WARN filing -> EFFECTIVE (separation) date -> expected initial-claims week -> conversion status. The notice date is NOT the claims date: WARN's 60-day rule means separations (and thus claims) land ~60d AFTER a notice, and severance runways can push actual UI filing later still. Track the EFFECTIVE date, not the filing date.

# SCOPE: material filings (>~50 wkrs) or thesis-relevant cohorts. TX auto-refreshable via scripts/warn_texas.py (TWC Excel). Multi-state tech cohort seeded from domain/sources/BIGTECH_WARN_CLUSTER_20260706.md. Not exhaustive of every US WARN — that's the aggregate WARN count in STATUS.

# STATUS vocab: FILED (notice posted, pre-effective) / EFFECTIVE (separations underway) / CLAIMS-EXPECTED (in the claims-appearance window now) / CONVERTED (claims uptick observed) / LAPSED-LOW (effective passed, no claims signal) / AWAITED (expected filing not yet posted).
# claims_window = ISO week initial-claims should first reflect it (effective_date + filing lag); severance can delay. Boot: boot.py surfaces a >30d staleness alert on this file.
